questions.question: Which new Zurich feature in CSM allows predefined templates to auto-apply based on case conditions, bringing structure to complex case handling?

explanation.correct: Task Plan Templates is a new Zurich feature that brings structure and speed to complex case handling. Predefined templates auto-apply based on case conditions, so agents no longer need to guess what comes next. Process owners can quickly adapt workflows to changing rules. See: https://www.servicenow.com/community/csm-blog/what-s-new-in-zurich-for-customer-service-management/ba-p/3331112

wrongAnswers.explanation: Case Workflow Builder is not the name of this Zurich feature. Task Plan Templates is the correct feature.
Dynamic Case Routing is not the Zurich feature for predefined task templates.
Case Automation Rules is not the correct name for this feature.

references: Zurich Release - What's New in CSM

source.excerpt: Task Plan Templates bring structure and speed with predefined templates that auto-apply based on case conditions.

questions.question: In Zurich, which new component allows CSM agents to view all customer activity—actor-related and non-actor-related—in a single, searchable timeline?

explanation.correct: The Customer History Component is new in Zurich and allows agents to view all customer activity in a single, searchable timeline. It can filter by type or date, refresh data dynamically, and be customized with milestones, icons, and branding. See: https://www.servicenow.com/community/csm-blog/what-s-new-in-zurich-for-customer-service-management/ba-p/3331112

wrongAnswers.explanation: Customer 360 View is not the specific Zurich feature name for this capability.
Activity Stream is not the correct name for this Zurich CSM feature.
Case Timeline Widget is not the name of this new Zurich component.

references: Zurich Release - What's New in CSM

source.excerpt: Customer History Component brings clarity and context into the agent's workspace with a searchable timeline of all customer activity.

questions.question: Which new Zurich store app helps CSM administrators classify and protect sensitive customer data including PII?

explanation.correct: Zurich introduces a CSM Data Privacy store app that simplifies classification of sensitive customer data. It provides out-of-the-box templates and integrates with ServiceNow Vault for privacy controls. See: https://www.servicenow.com/community/csm-blog/what-s-new-in-zurich-for-customer-service-management/ba-p/3331112

wrongAnswers.explanation: Data Loss Prevention is not the specific Zurich CSM feature for data classification.
Customer Data Vault is not the name of this Zurich store app.
PII Scanner is not the correct name for this feature.

references: Zurich Release - What's New in CSM

source.excerpt: Zurich introduces a CSM Data Privacy store app that simplifies classification and protection of sensitive CSM data including PII.

questions.question: What Zurich enhancement allows CSM agents to launch record producers directly from the service selector in the Configurable Workspace?

options.text: Record Producer in CSM Configurable Workspace

explanation.correct: Zurich allows agents to launch record producers directly from the CSM service selector in the Configurable Workspace. This lets admins reuse portal intake processes without rebuilding them, creating a unified intake experience. See: https://www.servicenow.com/community/csm-blog/what-s-new-in-zurich-for-customer-service-management/ba-p/3331112

wrongAnswers.explanation: Service Catalog Integration is too generic and not the specific Zurich feature name.
Quick Case Creator is not the correct name for this feature.
Universal Intake Form is not the Zurich feature for launching record producers from the workspace.

references: Zurich Release - What's New in CSM

source.excerpt: Zurich allows launching record producers directly from the CSM service selector in the Configurable Workspace.

questions.question: Which Zurich enhancement to the Declarative Framework allows admins to manage responsibility access configurations through a UI instead of custom scripting?

explanation.correct: Zurich enhances the Declarative Framework with UI-based responsibility access configurations. Admins can now set and view access controls through an intuitive interface using filters and table mappings, reducing the need for custom scripting. See: https://www.servicenow.com/community/csm-blog/what-s-new-in-zurich-for-customer-service-management/ba-p/3331112

wrongAnswers.explanation: Access Control Rules UI is not the specific Zurich feature name.
Role-Based Access Designer is not the correct name for this feature.
Permission Matrix Editor is not the Zurich Declarative Framework enhancement.

references: Zurich Release - What's New in CSM

source.excerpt: Zurich provides enhanced UI-based responsibility access configurations, reducing the need for custom scripting.
